NumberOfMagazines and InitialAmmo do not establish carried uses.
Damage composition, vehicle damage, guidance and locking are outside this bounded trace.

siteImpact: An optional anti-air comparison can present these reviewed serialized source fields, subject to operator review. No effective reload, carried-use, range or damage calculation is supported; no site files changed.
